lesson_title: Pap, the Maize Triangle and the Food Security Riddle
hook_text: There's maize on your plate twice tonight — and you only see it once.
clip_script: Start at supper. Pap, chicken, some gravy. Now trace the plate backwards. The pap was mealie meal, which was white maize, which grew on the highveld. The chicken was raised on feed made mostly from yellow maize — so there is maize on your plate twice, once visible and once hiding inside the chicken. Do that trace for the whole country and you have discovered why maize matters more than any percentage suggests: it is the floor under the national diet.
visual_style: A steaming plate of pap and chicken rewinding — chicken to feed to yellow maize, pap to meal to white maize — ending on a drone sweep over Free State grainlands and silos.
pacing: Warm hook at the table, quick rewind, wide landing on the triangle.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson — the Maize Triangle, two farming worlds, and the full-silos riddle solved.
